approved_scope.title: Refuse check, review, finalize and ship while a change has an open task, naming each open task and the command to re-run (#892)
approved_scope.description: Refuse check, review, finalize and ship while a change has an open task, naming each open task and the command to re-run (#892)
acceptance_criteria: A gate-level test drives each refusal through the binary, ticks the box and runs the exact command the refusal named, which succeeds; with the incomplete-task guard bypassed (audit mutation SS-M05) that test fails.

change check, change review (pass verdict), change finalize and change ship each refuse a change with an open task in its tasks.md before writing any record, including a task reopened after a passing check, and each refusal names the task file, every open task by line and text, and the exact command to re-run.
change status (text Next: and JSON summary.next_action) and change ship-status name the open tasks before the command that would otherwise be next, and ship-status reports them as a blocker.

answers.constraints: specs/change/change.3md: a workflow-v2 defect must be reproduced under workflow v2 and a refusal test asserts the refusal text, not only the exit status; status and ship-status must ask the gate directly rather than read a refusal as stale (the verification_ignored_paths lesson); a refusal must name a command that actually recovers and a test must run it (95% plan rule); no test, gate, bound or timeout is weakened
